# State & NFR Checklist: 高危操作确认 Toast 化（Auth Toast）

**Purpose**: Validate the quality of requirements for session-state boundaries, queue semantics, and quantified non-functional expectations before implementation and PR review.
**Created**: 2026-04-27
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are the auto-approve requirements explicit about all three scopes: the currently visible confirmation, already queued unseen confirmations, and future confirmations in the same session? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007, Spec §FR-007a, Spec §User Story 2]
- [ ] CHK002 Are the "new conversation" requirements explicit about both state reset and settlement of old-session pending confirmations, rather than assuming readers infer one from the other? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008, Spec §FR-017, Spec §CC-005]
- [ ] CHK003 Are exclusions for non-Assistant confirmation surfaces fully documented so reviewers can tell that PM/Trial flows and manual parameter dialogs are intentionally out of scope? [Completeness, Spec §FR-014, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK004 Is the "visible cue" for no-confirmation mode defined with concrete observable properties, instead of only the vague phrase "可见提示"? [Clarity, Spec §FR-013, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK005 Is "关键参数摘要" precise enough to tell reviewers what must always be shown for `write_file`, `edit_file`, and `exec`, and what must always be redacted or truncated? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003, Spec §Clarifications]
- [ ] CHK006 Is the "same frame or next frame" synchronization target written so it can be interpreted objectively during review without relying on implementation-specific knowledge? [Clarity, Spec §SC-004, Plan §Performance Goals]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK007 Are the quantity expectations for session auto-approve aligned between the User Story 2 example and the measurable outcome (`5` actions vs `10` actions)? [Consistency, Spec §User Story 2, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK008 Do timeout requirements remain consistent across functional behavior, compatibility constraints, edge-case wording, and measurable outcomes? [Consistency, Spec §FR-010, Spec §CC-003, Spec §Edge Cases, Spec §SC-006]
- [ ] CHK009 Are queue-settlement semantics consistent between the "全部允许" path, the top Toggle-on path, and the new-chat reset path? [Consistency, Spec §FR-007a, Spec §FR-017, Spec §User Story 3, Plan §Implementation approach]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK010 Can the non-blocking responsiveness target be objectively reviewed from the written requirement alone, including which interaction is measured and under what UI state? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-001, Plan §Performance Goals]
- [ ] CHK011 Is the concurrency success criterion specific enough to distinguish "FIFO with no loss" from weaker interpretations such as "eventually handled"? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §FR-011, Spec §SC-005]
- [ ] CHK012 Are the structured logging requirements measurable enough to determine completeness of `request_id`, decision source, wait duration, and redaction boundaries without inferring a hidden schema? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §FR-015, Spec §SC-007]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK013 Are requirements defined for the state transition where the top Toggle is turned off while an auth confirmation surface is already visible, including whether the visible request and queued requests are affected? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 3]
- [ ] CHK014 Are recovery/settlement requirements complete for switching conversations while a confirmation countdown is already in progress? [Coverage, Spec §FR-017, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK015 Does the spec define whether drained queued requests that were never shown still require the same logging guarantees as visible confirmations? [Coverage, Spec §FR-007a, Spec §FR-015, Spec §SC-007]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK016 Are coexistence requirements specific enough to cover how ordinary Toast placement and auth-toast placement avoid overlap when multiple confirmations are queued? [Edge Case Coverage, Spec §FR-012, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK017 Are requirements explicit about whether the currently visible confirmation is treated differently from queued confirmations when auto-approve is enabled mid-queue? [Edge Case Coverage, Spec §FR-007, Spec §FR-007a, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK018 Are all quantitative expectations written with clear units and reviewable boundaries, including `<= 100ms`, `<= 1s`, and `5 Worker` concurrency? [Non-Functional Requirements, Spec §SC-001, Spec §SC-005, Spec §SC-006]
- [ ] CHK019 Does the spec make clear whether the frame-level sync target in `SC-004` is a hard gate, a best-effort UX goal, or an observational tolerance? [Non-Functional Requirements, Spec §SC-004]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK020 Are assumptions about the existing `request_id`/`Event` protocol, `_CONFIRM_TIMEOUT`, and the current "new conversation" entry point validated as stable requirements rather than hidden code knowledge? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions, Plan §Implementation approach]
- [ ] CHK021 Are exclusions around config persistence, migrations, and new cross-module event surfaces explicit enough that reviewers can reject scope creep confidently? [Dependency, Spec §Data Store Impact, Spec §Event Impact, Plan §Technical Context]

## Authorization UX Requirements

- [ ] CHK022 Are the decision meanings for "全部允许", "同意", and "拒绝" defined without overlap, including whether each decision affects only the active request, queued requests, or future same-session requests? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004, Spec §FR-005, Spec §FR-006, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK023 Are requirements explicit enough to prevent the auth confirmation surface from being dismissed by non-decision interactions such as ordinary close controls or outside-area dismissal? [Completeness, Spec §FR-016, Spec §AuthToastSurface]
- [ ] CHK024 Are requirements for the displayed confirmation summary sufficient for users to understand risk without needing implementation knowledge of tool arguments? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003, Spec §AuthConfirmationRequest]
- [ ] CHK025 Are visual and placement requirements for the auth confirmation surface specific enough to distinguish it from ordinary success/error toasts while preserving their independent lifecycles? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012, Spec §Assumptions, Plan §Technical Context]

## Security & Privacy Requirements

- [ ] CHK026 Are redaction requirements defined separately for `write_file`, `edit_file`, and `exec`, including what fields are allowed in UI summaries and structured logs? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003, Spec §FR-015, Plan §Implementation approach]
- [ ] CHK027 Are requirements clear that auto-approve is session-memory only and must not be persisted in config, database, keyring, or other storage? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008, Spec §Data Store Impact, Plan §Technical Context]
- [ ] CHK028 Are structured logging requirements explicit about all decision sources, including user accept, user reject, timeout, allow-all, top Toggle, and new-chat settlement? [Coverage, Spec §FR-015, Spec §FR-017, Spec §SC-007]
- [ ] CHK029 Are security-sensitive boundaries for "high-risk tools" documented well enough to avoid accidental inclusion or exclusion if the tool list changes later? [Assumption, Spec §Clarifications, Spec §Assumptions]

## Compatibility & Architecture Requirements

- [ ] CHK030 Are compatibility requirements precise enough to protect the existing Worker-to-UI synchronous confirmation protocol while still allowing the UI presentation layer to change? [Consistency, Spec §CC-001, Plan §Summary, Plan §Structure Decision]
- [ ] CHK031 Are non-Assistant confirmation paths and manual parameter dialogs documented with enough scope detail to distinguish required regression coverage from intentionally unchanged behavior? [Coverage, Spec §FR-014, Spec §Edge Cases, Tasks §Phase 6]
- [ ] CHK032 Are layer-boundary requirements complete for the split where business tools own decision state and UI widgets own rendering/queue presentation? [Completeness, Spec §Layer Impact, Plan §Constitution Check, Plan §Post-Design Constitution Check]
- [ ] CHK033 Are requirements explicit that no new Repository, data-store migration, persistent config key, or cross-module blinker event is expected for this feature? [Dependency, Spec §Data Store Impact, Spec §Event Impact, Plan §Technical Context]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK034 Are acceptance criteria traceable from each user story to at least one functional requirement and one measurable outcome, especially for US2 and US3 state transitions? [Traceability, Spec §User Story 2, Spec §User Story 3, Spec §SC-002, Spec §SC-004]
- [ ] CHK035 Are the written success criteria complete enough to evaluate all final decision paths without relying on task descriptions or implementation tests as the source of truth? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-005, Spec §SC-006, Spec §SC-007]
